text:
zoe (procurement): Vendor Delta just flagged 8 H100s as 'RMA-hold' due to power-cable batch mismatch. ETA bumped from 14d -> 40d. PO-80999.
sam (supply-ops): Are these reserved for Dedicated pools or spare inventory?
zoe (procurement): Reserved for EU Dedicated pool. Vendor offered temporary loaners (same spec) for 6w at $120/day/unit or a 7% invoice credit if we accept delay.
mike (eng-runtime): Losing 8 will increase tail latency at EU edge by ~20% under nightly batch jobs. Cross-region reroute to US adds egress + replication cost (~€2k/week).
dmitri (vendor_delta): We can dispatch loaners immediately but they are refurbished; courier + customs DDP adds ~€450/unit. Loaners come with 2w swap window.
nana (logistics): Double check customs for refurbished units — some carriers want refurbishment declaration. Split AWB likely.
sam (supply-ops): Quick calc: loaner cost (120*42d) ~€5,040/unit + freight 450 => ~€5.5k/unit. Credit 7% on list price (~€9k/unit) = ~€630. If latency cost >5k, loaner; else accept credit.
mike (eng-runtime): Ops impact estimate: ~€36k over 6w if we don't loan, ~€4.5k/unit. Close call.
zoe (procurement): Counter-proposal to vendor: release 4 verified new units in 2w (no loaner) + 4 loaners now. Ask for 4% credit on delayed 4 and waive courier fee for loaners.
dmitri (vendor_delta): I can get management to approve waive of courier fee if you sign expedited-handling addendum. Will confirm serials and preflight logs EOD.
nana (logistics): Once serials are in, I'll prepare DAP booking and pre-clear docs. Ops-bot: make ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-8788 created: "Vendor Delta H100 RMA-hold + partial loaner plan". Assignees: ana, sam, zoe. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8788
zoe (procurement): Next steps: 1) Dmitri sends serials + preflight; 2) Logistics to book loaner courier; 3) Legal to draft addendum for waive; 4) Mike to validate temporary placement behind feature-flag. I'll loop in finance.
sam (supply-ops): tagging @dmitri please cc legal@vendor-delta on addendum.
dmitri (vendor_delta): Will do. Thanks everyone.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 72h for INF-8788 follow-up.
